Light-blue gradient rounded rectangles with drop shadows and straight dark-blue connectors, no axes, no values and no legend; the six connectors into "capability" converge on one point and visibly overlap at the node edge, and the whole diagram is a pasted SmartArt object rather than a drawn chart.

note: 20 PDF sheets with the running header "Team#43181"; the folio prints as "n/ 19" style and the layout pass measured 13 regions on 9 pages - 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 13, 16 and 17 - giving 8 figure rows and 4 table rows after 1 exclusion (the Figure 1 legend strip on p4), with nothing unaccounted. The paper prints 15 numbered exhibits - Figures 1 to 8 and Tables 1 to 7 - but three of the seven tables are typeset as plain text with no vector rule at all, so the layout pass produced no region for them and they sit outside the row ledger by construction: "Table 2: the number and the origin of refugees in 2015" on p7, the eleven-row "Table 4: Optimal flows of refugees of Model 1" on p9 and the eleven-row "Table 5: Optimal flows of refugees of Model 1" on p10, the last of the three misprinted with Model 1 in its caption although it follows the Model 2 map. They are named here rather than silently dropped, so this paper's table count is also not recoverable from the region list alone. Every caption prints BELOW its artwork, figure and table alike, verified against block coordinates; the Figure 1 caption is the only one in the batch printed without a separator ("Figure 1 Accessibility of movement routes") and one caption carries a real typo ("Camparation" for "Comparison"). Five of the eight figures are the same pasted Google Maps screenshot - p4, p6, p9, p10 and p13 - differing only in the overlay and in the values printed on the plate, and only p4 carries a legend; the other four leave the red-diamond / yellow-circle / blue-arrow encoding entirely unexplained, and the three solution maps print paired "(flow, percentage)" labels that no key ever decodes. The remaining three figures are a two-y-axis capacity-vs-arrival line chart with neither axis titled, the abstract node-link graph of the route network, and a SmartArt parameter hierarchy on p17. The paper's citation apparatus is thin and inconsistent: Figure 1 is pointed at twice with a lower-case "figure 1", Figures 5 and 7 are each introduced one page early with a "Figure N shows" sentence, one sentence names a table without a number ("Table shows the flows of refugees", referring to the p9 Table 4), and the other five figures and every measured table are introduced only as "the following".
rules: 题注位置照实测记：十二个印刷题注全部印在作品下方（position=below），图与表一致，用块坐标逐条核对过；这一批里 p4 的地图、p6 的两幅、p7 的三项、p9、p10、p11、p13、p16、p17 各一处，没有一处倒置。[caption.position]
图 1 的题注没有分隔符：p4 印作 "Figure 1 Accessibility of movement routes"，冒号缺失，故 numbering 记 "Figure N" 而不是 "Figure N:"；其余七图与四表都用冒号。[caption.numbering]
检出区域不等于展品：p4r2 是把图 1 地图右缘的三色图例（Accessibility index<10 等三条）单独切出的矢量块，与地图在本页并排，故以 fragment-of-other 排除，图 1 只记一行。[caption.verbatim]

无矢量线的表不入账但必须写明：p7 的 "Table 2：the number and the origin of refugees in 2015"、p9 的 "Table 4: Optimal flows of refugees of Model 1"、p10 的 "Table 5: Optimal flows of refugees of Model 1" 三张都是纯文字排版、没有任何矢量线，检测器没有给出区域，因此不进行台账，只在论文备注里逐张记明，避免计入 unaccounted；其中 Table 2 用的是全角冒号，Table 5 的题注误写成 Model 1。[table.header_rows]
线型按目视：p7 两张表、p16 一张表都只画横线（表头上一条、表头下一条、末行下一条），既不封外框也没有列分隔线，记 booktabs；p11 的 Table 6 多出一条贯穿全高的列分隔线，是全篇唯一有列线的表，记 vertical-rules。[table.rule_style]
单位只在 p16 的表头里：Table 7 表头印 "Ceiling(10 thousand persons)"，记 units_in_header=true；p7r3 的 "(persons)" 印在左侧符号栏而不在表头，记 false；其余各表无单位。[table.units_in_header]
五幅地图同源：p4、p6、p9、p10、p13 的图都是同一张粘贴的 Google Maps 底图截图（"Map data (c)2016 Google, ORION-ME" 与缩放条原样留在版面上），只有图 1 带图例，其余四幅的菱形/圆点编码全无说明，故 legend 记 none；五幅的东缘标签都被裁断（"Uzbe..."、"Afg..."）。[geometry.legend]
p9、p10、p13 三幅把数值直接印在图上：每处印成 "(流量, 百分比)" 的成对标签，但图上没有任何图例解释这两个数的含义，记 data_labels=true、legend=none 并在备注写明成对标签未解码，避免被当成已标注的图。[geometry.data_labels]

引用按纸面：图 1 被正文点过两次（p5 "corresponds with the figure 1"、p7 "to Europe into figure 1"），两处都写小写 figure；图 5 与图 7 各被 "Figure N shows" 句式点过一次（p8、p12），且都在图出现的前一页；其余四图、四表与三张未入账的表全篇无编号点名，p8 只有一句不带编号的 "Table shows the flows of refugees" 指向 p9 的 Table 4。[mention.style]

tables.note: the definition table for the model: two columns "Variable" and "Definition" over five symbol rows (n_i, m_j, c_j, a_ij, x_ij). Open booktabs - a rule above the header, a rule below it and a rule below the last row, no left or right frame, no row rules and no column separators apart from two short header strokes. No units column; the subscript joins are printed without spaces in the definitions ("ofB_j", "toB_j").

the living-quality and capacity matrix that follows the sentence "We use the number and the origin of refugees in 2015": twelve columns - an unheaded stub carrying the row symbols plus B1 to B11 - and only two data rows, c_i (eleven living-quality indices to four decimals) and m_i (capacities, with "(persons)" printed as a second line in the stub). Open booktabs with no frame and no column rules. The caption names only the living-quality index although the same grid also carries the capacities, so caption and artwork disagree.

the dynamic-model symbol table: two columns "Variable" and "Definition" over fifteen rows, t through x_ij(t), with the definition cells right-aligned rather than left-aligned. Rules are a top rule, a rule under the header and a bottom rule plus one full-height vertical separator between the two columns, and no left or right frame - so it is the only table in the paper with a column rule, recorded as vertical-rules. Units are inlined in the definition text ("Month 0 <= t <= 12") except for the time variable, so there is no units header.
